headline: Pickleball court proposal location at Slater Park and John St. playground work; also Arts Festival review and October events.
summary: The meeting will cover a proposed pickleball court location at Slater Park and an update on the John St. playground. It will also review the Arts Festival and October events.
items: Pickleball court proposal location at Slater Park
Update on John St. playground work
Current status of parks and facilities

CITY OF PAWTUCKET 
PARKS COMMISSION 
SLATER MEMORIAL PARK 
PAWTUCKET, RHODE ISLAND 02861 
 
 
Dave Farrell 
CHAIRPERSON 
 
 
There will be a meeting of the: 
Pawtucket Parks Commission on Tuesday September 8th, 2026 at 
7:00 p.m. at, Pawtucket, RI 02861 
 
This meeting is being called by Dave Farrell, Chairperson of the Parks Commission. 
 
The purpose of the meeting is as follows: 
 
1.)  ROLL CALL 
 
2.)  PUBLIC INPUT 
Visitors requesting to participate during the public input portion are required to sign in by 6:45 pm. 
 
3.)  APPROVE AND ACCEPT MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETING 
 
4.) CHAIRMANS' UPDATE 
 
5.)  REVIEW OLD BUSINESS 
      
Pickle ball Court -Slater Park proposal location  
Update on John St. playground work. 
 
6.)  NEW BUSINESS 
           
           Nominations for Parks Commission office  
           Review of Arts Festival 
 Update of October Events   
            
           
  7.)  PARKS & RECREATION UPDATE 
Current status of parks and facilities 
Parks and citywide tree update. 
 
8.) OPEN FORUM 
 
9.) MOTION TO ADJOURN 
 
The agendas and past monthly meeting minutes are available at the Slater Park office one week before the meeting date 
noted above. For further information, call the City of Pawtucket Recreation Office at 728-0500 x251.
